text: 34 In healthy men, a large controlled trial35 found that seven years of finasteride prophylaxis reduced the in- cidence of prostate cancer by about 25% compared with placebo, but this benefit was offset by an increased risk of high-grade tumours associated with finasteride. Dutas- teride is also under investigation.36 Results from a case- control study have suggested an association between war- farin use and a decreased risk of prostate cancer.37 There is preliminary evidence that selenium (see p.1961) or vita- min E (see p.1927) supplementation may also reduce the risk of prostate cancer, and a large randomised study is un- derway to further investigate this. 1.
